question: The genus name of ______ is Cucurbita.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pumpkin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The genus name of **Pumpkin is Cucurbita.**
 
• Cucurbitaceae is also called a **gourds family.**
